i1.title: Jimmy Choo I Want Choo Midnight Eau de Parfum 100ml
i1.descriptionHtml:
A darker, after-hours take on I Want Choo.

Jimmy Choo I Want Choo Midnight Eau de Parfum 100ml is a floral fragrance for women, launched in 2026 as the after-dark chapter of the I Want Choo story. A juicy blackberry opening leads into a heart of night orchid, before the scent settles onto a smooth, woody base of cedarwood for a confident evening trail.

Scent pyramid

  • Top: Blackberry
  • Heart: Night Orchid
  • Base: Cedarwood

Key details

  • Brand: Jimmy Choo
  • Concentration: Eau de Parfum
  • Size: 100ml
  • Scent profile: Floral · Fruity
  • Wear: Women

Why you'll love it

  • A juicy blackberry opening
  • A sensual night orchid heart
  • A smooth cedarwood base
  • Generous 100ml Eau de Parfum

FAQ

What does I Want Choo Midnight smell like?

Blackberry first, then night orchid, finishing with cedarwood.

Is it for women?

Yes, it is a women's fragrance.

i2.title: Lalique Pour Homme Lion Eau de Parfum 125ml
i2.descriptionHtml:
A bold, noble woody aromatic with a lion's presence.

Lalique Pour Homme Lion Eau de Parfum 125ml is a woody aromatic fragrance for men, created by perfumer Maurice Roucel and launched in 1997. Bright bergamot, grapefruit and mandarin meet aromatic lavender and rosemary in the opening, a heart of iris, jasmine and cedarwood adds polish, and it settles into a warm, rich base of oakmoss, amber, patchouli, sandalwood and vanilla.

  • Base: Oakmoss, Amber, Patchouli, Sandalwood, Vanilla

  • Concentration: Eau de Parfum
  • Size: 125ml

Why you'll love it

  • An elegant iris, jasmine and cedarwood heart
  • A warm amber, sandalwood and vanilla base
  • Generous 125ml Eau de Parfum

FAQ

What does Lalique Pour Homme Lion smell like?

Bitter almond, cardamom and mandarin open it bright and lightly spiced, a heart of pear, coffee and jasmine adds a creamy, radiant sweetness, and it settles into a soft base of musk, sandalwood and praline.
